docs.packageUiDescription: This package exports a separate UI entry point. Its specifier is listed below.
docs.guide.env.summary: Use a typed contract for build-time environment files generated by the Angular CLI schematic.
docs.guide.env.contract: BaseEnvironment requires readonly production and version fields; add application-specific fields in your own interface.
docs.guide.env.buildTime: Angular replaces the selected environment file during the build. Values included in a browser bundle are public, so do not store secrets there.
docs.guide.env.schematic: Run ng add @rivinia/env in an Angular CLI workspace to scaffold environment files and build replacements.
docs.guide.env.api.baseEnvironment: Type contract for the required production and version properties.
docs.guide.env.api.schematic: CLI schematic that creates environment files and build configuration replacements.
docs.guide.http.summary: Use one typed client for Observable requests and signal-driven Angular HTTP resources.
docs.guide.http.client: RiviniaHttp delegates to Angular HttpClient, so application interceptors and HttpContext remain available.
docs.guide.http.resource: Use getResource for reactive GET requests; a signal or reactive endpoint can trigger refetching, and undefined disables the request.
docs.guide.http.envelopes: Response bodies pass through by default. Envelope unwrapping and failure validation are opt-in request or provider policies.
docs.guide.http.api.inject: Injects the configured RiviniaHttp client into an Angular service.
docs.guide.http.api.joinUrl: Joins a base URL and endpoint without duplicate slashes; absolute HTTP URLs pass through.
docs.guide.http.api.resource: Creates a reactive GET resource with Angular httpResource state.
docs.guide.i18n.summary: Keep dictionaries, language state, text direction, and locale formatting synchronized from one Angular service.
docs.guide.i18n.languageState: Configure each language with its id, native name, direction, and locale; the manager exposes the active language and direction as signals.
docs.guide.i18n.translations: Use the rvTranslate pipe in templates, t() for signal-backed component text, or translate() in ordinary TypeScript code.
docs.guide.i18n.icu: ICU messages support plural, select, selectordinal, offsets, and number/date formatting, including Arabic plural categories.
docs.guide.i18n.api.manager: Language state, translation lookup, switching, and locale information.
docs.guide.i18n.api.pipe: Template pipe that updates translated text when the active language changes.
docs.guide.i18n.api.define: Defines typed language configuration and helpers for application bootstrap.
docs.guide.theme.summary: Set semantic CSS custom properties once so Rivinia components share the same palette and color scheme.
docs.guide.theme.tokens: Map tokens such as --rv-bg, --rv-fg, and --rv-accent in the application's global stylesheet.
docs.guide.theme.schemes: The stylesheet includes light and dark values; data-rv-theme on the document element selects a scheme.
docs.guide.theme.adapters: Choose one base stylesheet or stack adapter. An adapter includes the base theme, so importing both duplicates CSS.
docs.guide.theme.api.base: Base stylesheet with the default semantic tokens for Rivinia components.
docs.guide.theme.api.css: Explicit stylesheet entry point for bundlers that need a file path.
docs.guide.theme.api.adapters: Tailwind, Bootstrap, and Sass adapter entry points for existing styling stacks.
docs.guide.menu.summary: Build accessible action menus with a ready-made UI or the headless menu controller.
docs.guide.menu.actions: Use this menu-button pattern for actions. It is not a navigation menubar or a general-purpose listbox.
docs.guide.menu.keyboard: The UI supports arrow navigation, typeahead, Escape to close and restore trigger focus, and Tab to leave the menu without trapping focus.
docs.guide.menu.layers: The UI entry provides rendering and keyboard/focus behavior. The headless entry tracks menu state and items while your application owns markup and semantics.
docs.guide.menu.api.controller: Headless controller for open state, item registration, active item, and keyboard movement.
docs.guide.menu.api.component: Ready-made menu component with declarative items or projected menu rows.
docs.guide.menu.api.trigger: Marks the trigger element and emits the selected item's id after the menu closes.
docs.guide.popup.summary: Use shared headless helpers to position popup panels and attach dismissal listeners.
docs.guide.popup.position: Calculate viewport coordinates from trigger and panel geometry, placement, and text direction; the result reports when vertical placement flips.
docs.guide.popup.dismissal: Bind outside-pointer, scroll, and resize dismissal for an open popup. Angular DestroyRef cleans up listeners; null browser objects are safe.
docs.guide.popup.boundary: This package provides no markup, styles, open state, focus policy, keyboard handling, or row semantics; the host component owns those decisions.
docs.guide.popup.api.position: Calculates clamped popup coordinates for the supplied geometry and placement.
docs.guide.popup.api.dismissal: Registers dismissal listeners and cleans them up with the host lifecycle.
docs.guide.popup.api.constants: Default trigger gap and viewport edge inset used by the positioning helper.
docs.guide.select.summary: Choose between the headless selection controller and the ready-made select field; both use the same single- or multi-value model.
docs.guide.select.modes: Single mode selects one value and closes. Multiple mode toggles values and keeps the list open so the user can continue selecting.
docs.guide.select.filtering: Search filtering is case- and accent-insensitive and normalizes Arabic tashkeel, tatweel, and alef forms.
docs.guide.select.forms: The ready-made component implements Angular FormValueControl and works with Signal Forms, Reactive Forms, and ngModel.
docs.guide.select.api.controller: Headless registry, filter, and selected-value controller.
docs.guide.select.api.component: Ready-made field that renders the popup, options, and keyboard/focus behavior.
docs.guide.select.api.change: Value type emitted by the UI; its shape depends on single or multiple mode.
docs.guide.datepicker.summary: Select civil Gregorian dates or date-times with optional UI, locale formatting, keyboard navigation, and explicit time-zone handling.
docs.guide.datepicker.civilValues: RiviniaDate and RiviniaDateTime represent calendar values; time-zone conversion is an explicit operation rather than an implicit Date conversion.
docs.guide.datepicker.timeZones: Use the time-zone helpers to resolve wall time and daylight-saving ambiguity for a named zone.
docs.guide.datepicker.locale: Locale controls date/time formatting, hour cycle, labels, and direction; the UI supports RTL and Angular forms.
docs.guide.datepicker.api.values: Civil date and date-time value types accepted by the controller and UI.
docs.guide.datepicker.api.controller: Headless calendar state and navigation controller.
docs.guide.datepicker.api.components: Ready-made date-only and date-time form controls from the UI entry point.
docs.guide.table.summary: Model typed rows and columns with a headless signal pipeline, then render them with the optional grid UI or custom markup.
docs.guide.table.typedColumns: Define columns against the row type so accessors, cell values, and table state stay connected to your data model.
docs.guide.table.pipeline: The core includes search, filters, sorting, pagination, row selection, and row/column span calculations.
docs.guide.table.customization: Use the ready-made grid to render the model, or keep the controller and render custom table markup.
docs.guide.table.api.create: Creates the reactive table model from signal-backed column and data options.
docs.guide.table.api.column: Builds a typed column definition and accessor.
docs.guide.table.api.paginate: Returns the requested page and paging metadata for rows.
docs.guide.modal.summary: Open typed modal content and receive typed results while configuring admission, dismissal, and lifecycle policies.
docs.guide.modal.typedResults: Pass a data type when opening a modal and receive a result that distinguishes confirmed, dismissed, and other completion states.
docs.guide.modal.guards: Async guards can prevent dismissal, allowing unsaved changes or validation to be handled before the modal closes.
docs.guide.modal.admission: Choose stack or queue admission for multiple modals; the optional UI host handles dialog rendering and positioning.
docs.guide.modal.api.provider: Registers the modal manager and its lifecycle configuration.
docs.guide.modal.api.open: Opens typed content with data, a stable reference, metadata, and dismissal options.
docs.guide.modal.api.result: Handle for awaiting a typed modal completion result.
docs.guide.toast.summary: Queue transient notifications through a signal-based service and render them with the optional toast-list UI.
docs.guide.toast.queue: The service manages toast state, timers, deduplication, and overflow independently from how notifications are rendered.
docs.guide.toast.actions: A toast may include an action; choose a kind and duration that fit the message and allow users enough time to respond.
docs.guide.toast.layers: Use the service headlessly when needed, or render the managed list component from the separate UI entry point.
docs.guide.toast.api.inject: Injects the toast service into an Angular component or service.
docs.guide.toast.api.show: Adds a configured notification to the managed queue.
docs.guide.toast.api.list: Renders and manages visible notifications from the UI entry point.
